links.outcome: Predictive value of CDST risk groups for clinical, endoscopic outcomes and persistence in local real-world cohort
links.effect: CDST failed to predict PRO-2 clinical remission; in CD it associated with week-52 CSFR (p=0.04), endoscopic outcomes (p<0.001), persistence (p=0.004); no predictive association in UC.
links.quote: In UC, no predictive association was observed for either clinical or endoscopic outcomes nor treatment persistence; however, we observed relatively high remission rates despite CDST-based stratification.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of an existing clinical decision support predictive tool (VDZ-CDST) in a real-world patient cohort to evaluate its predictive performance across clinical endpoints.
